notice: Labs features are still in development. They may be unstable and may change or be removed in later versions. Each one has its own switch and can be turned off at any time; use Feedback to tell us about problems.
emptyDescription: New features appear here when they enter testing.
saveFailed: Couldn't save: {error}. The switch was restored.
unavailable.runtime: The connected Runtime doesn't support this feature. Update Pisper on that machine to turn it on.
feature.bots.title: Bots
feature.bots.description: Create several always-on Bots and tell them what to do in a chat. They work on their own computer, use a separate branch for code changes and hand the result to you to confirm.
feature.bots.whenOff: Your Bots and their chats are kept and Bots disappear from the sidebar; running tasks finish.
